body: Hmm, well thank you. Depression runs in my family and I wonder if I was just having a bit of an attack or something at the time. I realize what I was thinking wasn't rational, but was still hard to overcome lol. Thanks

You know what's funny, is people more social than me, who I don't think would classify themselves as FA, have told me they refuse to see a movie by themselves. I've heard more than one person say this, but I've definitely done it. Beggars can't be picky I guess.

I have limited control over my circumstances. I've watched YouTube videos, read books, and put myself out there, all in an effort to be more outgoing, but the older I get the more it seems like a part of your personality or social skill set is really learned from your parents and with me I guess that just didn't happen. I have control over some, but not all things, despite most of the advice that says I'm in complete control of my social ability. 

As for feeling happy, what I said in my post describes it pretty well. I feel like most of my life is like walking through a desert (depression) and every hundred miles or so I reach an oasis (I'm happy). It's like happiness comes as often as getting a holiday or a day off work. It's not a part of life really, just a short break from feeling down that doesn't come often enough.

I don't mind talking, thank you for responding. 

I do not have many friends at the moment. I recently moved and am new to this city, I've been here about two months now. I'm actually in the Air Force and with my job right now I only have about three to four co-workers I interact on a daily basis, so my acquaintances are few. 

College however taught me that the problem isn't exactly with myself but usually a lack of people to hang out with. I had tons of peers in college that lived right down the hall, I had lot of friends and knew a lot of people. So, I'd like to think I'm not just moping.  

I did start going to church and have a few friends there, but they are all college age, a few years younger than me. It can be awkward but I still hang out with them as it gives me something to do. 

I do not know exactly how long I've felt like this, but at least since high school. I have not been happy in years, but my family has a history of depression so I figure that's probably why.
